title: 第1148章 别说话为师要装个大的第1147章 七大长生家族
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
墨羽不以为意，伸手便将身旁清冷绝尘的雪玥儿拉入自己怀中，大大方方地揽着。
“他们对我老婆不利，那我肯定不能惯着他们。”
“结仇便结仇了，迟早灭了他们满门。”
凤九幽闻言，凤眸微眯，目光落在雪玥儿那张绝美的清冷仙颜上，细细打量了一番。
旋即，她眼底的狐疑更甚，转而看向墨羽。
“那只小白虎那么凶，她能容忍你在外面找别的女子做老婆？”
墨羽轻笑一声。
“我家娘子一向很开明的好不好。”
凤九幽微怔，红唇轻启，一时竟无言以对。
她与那小白虎相识那么久，实在无法理解，她怎么会……
可脑海中忽地浮现出方才那两名仙尊老怪抱着墨羽大腿痛哭流涕的荒诞景象，心下便也释然。
这说明，小白虎认为他值得。
凤九幽嘴角抑制不住地微微上扬。
这家伙，真是越来越让人好奇了。
一行人离了传送阵，向城外行去。
未及多远，虚空忽生微漪，一抹紫裙倩影悄无声息地浮现于墨羽身侧。
“师尊。”
墨羽顺势伸手，将那温香软玉般的娇躯揽入怀中，低声笑问。
“咱们现在去哪？”
叶汐湄倾城的仙颜上漾起清浅笑意，顺势靠在他怀里，丝毫不避讳旁人的目光。

“先去天玄仙宗吧，为师想回去看看，当年那些老东西们如今修炼到什么地步了。”
回想当年那些老匹夫飞升之际，偏要拉着她去观礼凑热闹。
说什么老祖宗必须在场。
其实就是想跟自己炫耀。
如今自己证道仙帝回去，他们那惊掉下巴的表情……
念及此处，叶汐湄的嘴角便压制不住地上扬。
除了黛泠绾，在场三名仙尊全愣住了。
凤九幽、嵇霖宁、苏青秋，三双美眸齐齐一凝，足下顿止，背脊发寒。
为何她们毫无察觉？
以仙尊级的感知力，竟完全看不透这位凭空出现的紫裙女子。
她究竟是什么人？！
墨羽环着叶汐湄柔软的纤腰，轻声道。
“师尊，师姐现在应该也在天玄仙宗。”
叶汐湄慵懒地颔首。
浩瀚神识如水波般漫过整个圣源界，她的眼底掠过一丝微讶。
“这魂族，倒是没我想象中的那般暴虐。”
“如今圣源界尽归魂族统治，这天下反而异常平稳，井然有序。”
说罢，她素手一挥。
众人只觉眼前光影流转，脚下景物瞬息万变。
再定睛时，已立足于一座仙气氤氲的雄伟大门前。
content_en:
Mo Yu didn't take it seriously, and stretched out his hand to pull the cold and pure Xue Yue'er beside him into his arms, hugging her generously.
"They are not good for my wife, so I definitely can't spoil them."
"If you make enemies, you will make enemies. Sooner or later, they will be wiped out."
Hearing this, Feng Jiuyou narrowed her eyes slightly, her gaze fell on Xue Yue'er's beautiful cold face, and she looked at it carefully.
Immediately, the suspicion in her eyes became even more intense, and she turned to look at Mo Yu.
"That little white tiger is so fierce, can she tolerate you looking for another woman to be your wife outside?"
Mo Yu chuckled.
"My wife has always been very open-minded, okay?"
Feng Jiuyou was slightly startled, her red lips parted slightly, and she was speechless for a moment.
She had known the little white tiger for so long, and she really couldn't understand how she could...
But suddenly the absurd scene of the two immortal old monsters hugging Mo Yu's thighs and crying bitterly appeared in his mind, and he felt relieved.
This shows that the little white tiger thinks he is worthy.
The corners of Feng Jiuyou's mouth could not help but rise slightly.
This guy is getting more and more curious.
The group of people left the teleportation array and headed outside the city.
Not too far away, a slight ripple suddenly appeared in the void, and a beautiful figure in a purple skirt quietly appeared beside Mo Yu.
"Master."
Mo Yu stretched out his hand, took the warm and soft jade-like body into his arms, and asked with a low voice.
"Where are we going now?"
A faint smile appeared on Ye Ximei's beautiful face, and she leaned into his arms without shying away from the eyes of others.
"Let's go to Tianxuan Immortal Sect first. I want to go back and see how far those old guys have reached in their cultivation now."
Recalling that when those old men were promoted to heaven, they would drag her to watch the ceremony and join in the fun.
It is said that the ancestors must be present.
In fact, I just want to show off to myself.
Now that he has returned as the Immortal Emperor, they will see their jaw-dropping expressions...
Thinking of this, the corners of Ye Ximei's mouth couldn't help but rise.
Except for Dai Lingwan, the three immortals present were all stunned.
Feng Jiuyou, Ji Linning, and Su Qingqiu, all three pairs of beautiful eyes were focused together. They paused and felt a chill running down their backs.
Why didn't they notice?
With his immortal-level perception, he could not see through this woman in a purple dress who appeared out of thin air.
Who is she? !
Mo Yu hugged Ye Ximei's soft waist and said softly.
"Master, senior sister should be in Tianxuan Immortal Sect now."
Ye Ximei nodded lazily.
The vast spiritual consciousness spread across the entire Holy Source Realm like water waves, and a trace of surprise flashed in her eyes.
"This soul clan is not as violent as I imagined."
"Now that the Holy Origin World is under the rule of the Soul Clan, the world is extremely stable and orderly."
After saying that, she waved her hand.
Everyone could only feel the light and shadow flowing in front of their eyes, and the scenery under their feet was changing rapidly.
When I focused my eyes again, I was standing in front of a majestic gate full of fairy spirit.
